ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones on distal lobes; heavy black mottling and solid pigmentation concentrated near the central notch and along the leading edges; significant stippling on the inner-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 130 degrees; vertex partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous boundary; peaks vary between 5-15 pixels in depth relative to the adjacent valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges curving toward acutely pointed distal tips; leading edges show a smoother convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel clusters scattered across the white ventral field of the right lobe; white focal clusters visible on the dark terminal edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, diagonal light-colored linear marks (rake-like disruptions) located on the dark pigmentation of the proximal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear rake marks on the inner left lobe; irregular jagged scarring on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown chromatic anomaly (patch) on the high-intensity white region of the left lobe.
